subject: Parcelwise inbound: demo + traffic profile
messages:
From: Emily Chan <emily.chan@parcelwise.ai>
To: avery_johnson@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood evaluation inquiry and traffic profile

Hi Avery,

I signed up for the self-serve flow and wanted to reach out directly. We are evaluating Redwood for inference serving for our recommendation and search reranking pipelines. Quick context: 
- Use case: product recommendations + search reranking (real-time scoring)
- Current traffic: ~350 req/s steady, daily peaks ~520 req/s during promos
- Typical request: 120 tokens in prompt, 30 tokens returned on average
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for the scoring endpoint
- Timeline: POC targeted for Nov 2026, production rollout in Q1 2027
- Data residency: US (prefer us-east region)

I attached a small traffic_estimates.csv with hour-by-hour sample for a peak week and a simple load projection. Two asks: 1) Can we do a short demo focused on throughput, batching, and latency under concurrent load? 2) Any pre-demo questions you need answered to scope the session?

Thanks,
Emily Chan
Head of Machine Learning, Parcelwise
emily.chan@parcelwise.ai
+1 (415) 555-0188

Attachment: traffic_estimates.csv (csv, 14 KB)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chan <emily.chan@parcelwise.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation inquiry and traffic profile

Hi Emily — thanks for the detail and for the CSV, that helps a lot. Happy to run a throughput-focused demo and walk through batching and KV cache behavior. A few quick qualification items so we tailor the session: 
- Which model family are you planning to serve (open LLM for reranking, in-house transformer, or embedding-only pipeline)?
- Do you need persistent KV caches between requests or is each request stateless?
- Is there an SSO/SSO-provided SAML requirement for the demo environment?
- Any regulatory requirements besides US residency (PCI, HIPAA)?

Proposed slots (all PT) next week — pick one and I will lock it: 
- Tue Sep 7, 9:30am - 10:00am PT
- Wed Sep 8, 11:00am - 11:30am PT
- Thu Sep 9, 2:00pm - 2:30pm PT

Or use our quick scheduler: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min.

Ben and Monica are looped in to help with pre-demo infra questions and so Monica can lead the ops/throughput portion. If you can reply with the preferred slot and a short confirmation of model type + whether you plan to use online embeddings in the same path, we will prepare a focused agenda.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai

--

Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation inquiry and traffic profile

Thanks, Avery — appreciate the fast reply. Slot works for us. Answers inline below: 
- Model: We will serve a distilled transformer (internal) for reranking; embeddings are computed separately and stored, so embedding compute is not in the hot path for each request.
- KV cache: Not required between independent scoring calls; stateless requests are fine for the demo.
- SSO: Not required for the POC, but we will need SAML SSO for production.
- Compliance: No HIPAA/PCI scope for this workload.

Confirmed slot: Tue Sep 7, 9:30am PT. Can you share a short agenda? We'd like a 20-25 minute demo covering: 
1) Runtime throughput and continuous batching behavior under concurrent requests
2) Typical latencies (p50/p95) with caching off vs on
3) Autoscaling behavior and failover/fallback options
4) Quick pricing/quantization recommendation for cost targets

Attaching a quick architecture_sketch.pdf that shows how the model and request path sits in our infra. Also FYI we plan to run a small synthetic traffic run during the demo to validate behavior.

Thanks,
Emily

Attachment: architecture_sketch.pdf (pdf, 48 KB)

- Action items for us: create sandbox API key, pre-warm a small test model, prepare a simple load scenario (we can replay a subset of traffic_estimates.csv).

Tagging Ben to handle calendar invite and to confirm the room (Zoom + remote screenshare).
